AnthropicBeta.description:
Beta names you can send in the `anthropic-beta` header.

See [Beta headers](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta-headers) for how to send them and where to find the name a feature needs.

BetaGoogleManagedDataControls.description: A user profile's encryption key and storage bucket settings for Claude on Google Cloud's Agent Platform. Every user profile has one of these objects. You can read and update it, but not create or delete it. Keys and buckets are set for each region. A request's region depends on the Google endpoint it is sent to: `us` is the US multi-region endpoint and the regional endpoint of every location whose name starts with `us-`, `eu` is the EU multi-region endpoint and the regional endpoint of every location whose name starts with `europe-`, `sg` is the `asia-southeast1` regional endpoint, and `global` is the global endpoint, wherever Google serves the request. Anthropic may add regions.

bucket_label_value.description: The label value that every bucket set up for this profile must have. It never changes.

cmek.description: The customer-managed encryption key control: the key in the end customer's Google Cloud KMS that is set for each region.

storage.description: The customer-owned storage control: the end customer's Cloud Storage bucket that is set for each region.

updated_at.description: When an update last changed a control, or a region's status last changed, in RFC 3339 format. A region that starts or stops reading `suspended`, a change to `last_checked_at` alone, and the removal of a retired entry do not count.

user_profile_id.description: The ID of the user profile that these controls belong to (`uprof_...`).

BetaGoogleManagedCmekControl.description: The customer-managed encryption key control, discriminated by `type`.

BetaGoogleManagedStorageControl.description: The customer-owned storage control, discriminated by `type`.

BetaGoogleManagedCmekDisabled.description: The control is off and has no keys.

retired_keys.description: Keys that a region has retired, earliest `expires_at` first.

BetaGoogleManagedCmekEnabled.description: The control is on and has a key for at least one region.

external_key_ids.description: The ID of the External Key configured for each region (`ekey_...`), keyed by region code. A region with no key is left out.

retired_keys.description: Keys that a region has retired, earliest `expires_at` first.

status.description: Each region's status for the control, keyed by region code. A region that your organization is not offered may have no entry, and Anthropic may add regions.

BetaGoogleManagedStorageDisabled.description: The control is off and has no buckets.

retired_buckets.description: Buckets that a region has retired, earliest `expires_at` first.

BetaGoogleManagedStorageEnabled.description: The control is on and has a bucket for at least one region.

buckets.description: The bucket configured for each region, keyed by region code. A region with no bucket is left out.

retired_buckets.description: Buckets that a region has retired, earliest `expires_at` first.

status.description: Each region's status for the control, keyed by region code. A region that your organization is not offered may have no entry, and Anthropic may add regions.

BetaGoogleManagedRetiredKey.description: A key that a region has retired. Keep the key usable until `expires_at`.

expires_at.description: When this entry is removed, in RFC 3339 format.

external_key_id.description: The ID of the retired External Key (`ekey_...`).

region.description: The code of the region that retired the key.

BetaGoogleManagedCmekRegionStatuses.description: One status for each region, keyed by region code.

BetaGoogleManagedRetiredBucket.description: A bucket that a region has retired. Until `expires_at`, keep the bucket and Anthropic's access to it as they were when the bucket passed verification.

expires_at.description: When this entry is removed, in RFC 3339 format.

project_number.description: The number of the Google Cloud project that holds the bucket, in decimal.

region.description: The code of the region that retired the bucket.

BetaGoogleManagedStorageBucket.description: The bucket configured for a region.

kms_key_name.description: The resource name of the Cloud KMS key that the bucket encrypts objects under by default. `null` until the region has confirmed the bucket, and when the bucket has no default key.

location.description: The bucket's location, as Cloud Storage reports it. `null` until the region has confirmed the bucket.

project_id.description: The ID of the project that holds the bucket. `null` until the region has confirmed the bucket.

project_number.description: The number of the Google Cloud project that holds the bucket, in decimal.

BetaGoogleManagedStorageRegionStatuses.description: One status for each region, keyed by region code.

BetaGoogleManagedCmekRegionStatus.description: One region's status for the `cmek` control, discriminated by `type`.

BetaGoogleManagedStorageRegionStatus.description: One region's status for the `storage` control, discriminated by `type`.

BetaGoogleManagedCmekRegionNotConfigured.description: No key is set for this region.

effective_external_key_id.description: The ID of the External Key that the region applies now (`ekey_...`). While a replacement key is `pending` or `failed`, this is the previous key. `null` when the region applies no key.

BetaGoogleManagedCmekRegionPending.description: The region is validating the configured key, or the key has passed validation and the region has not started to apply it.

effective_external_key_id.description: The ID of the External Key that the region applies now (`ekey_...`). While a replacement key is `pending` or `failed`, this is the previous key. `null` when the region applies no key.

error.description: Why the latest validation attempt failed. `null` when no attempt has failed.

BetaGoogleManagedCmekRegionActive.description: The configured key passed validation, and the region applies it.

effective_external_key_id.description: The ID of the External Key that the region applies now (`ekey_...`). While a replacement key is `pending` or `failed`, this is the previous key. `null` when the region applies no key.

error.description: Why Google Cloud KMS refused the region's latest use of the key. `null` when the region has no refusal to report. A `null` does not mean that the key works.

last_checked_at.description: When the region last got a successful answer from Google Cloud KMS for the key, in RFC 3339 format. `null` when it has none to report.

validated_at.description: When the status last became `active`, in RFC 3339 format.

BetaGoogleManagedCmekRegionFailed.description: The region stopped retrying validation before the configured key passed. To restart validation, send the region a key again. It can be the same key.

effective_external_key_id.description: The ID of the External Key that the region applies now (`ekey_...`). While a replacement key is `pending` or `failed`, this is the previous key. `null` when the region applies no key.

error.description: Why the region cannot use the configured key.

BetaGoogleManagedCmekRegionSuspended.description: Anthropic has withdrawn or paused its approval of customer-managed keys for this profile, so the region does not apply the control.

effective_external_key_id.description: The ID of the External Key that the region applies now (`ekey_...`). While a replacement key is `pending` or `failed`, this is the previous key. `null` when the region applies no key.

BetaGoogleManagedStorageRegionNotConfigu.description: No bucket is set for this region.

effective_bucket.description: The bucket that the region applies now. While a replacement bucket is `pending` or `failed`, this is the previous bucket. `null` when the region applies no bucket.

BetaGoogleManagedStorageRegionPending.description: The region is verifying the configured bucket.

effective_bucket.description: The bucket that the region applies now. While a replacement bucket is `pending` or `failed`, this is the previous bucket. `null` when the region applies no bucket.

failed_checks.description: The checks that the latest reported verification attempt failed. Empty when none has failed.

BetaGoogleManagedStorageRegionActive.description: The configured bucket passed verification, and the region applies it.

effective_bucket.description: The bucket that the region applies now. While a replacement bucket is `pending` or `failed`, this is the previous bucket. `null` when the region applies no bucket.

failed_checks.description: The checks that the latest reported daily verification failed. Empty when it passed.

validated_at.description: When the status last became `active`, in RFC 3339 format.

BetaGoogleManagedStorageRegionFailed.description: The region stopped retrying verification before the configured bucket passed. To restart verification, send the region a bucket again. It can be the same bucket.

effective_bucket.description: The bucket that the region applies now. While a replacement bucket is `pending` or `failed`, this is the previous bucket. `null` when the region applies no bucket.

failed_checks.description: The checks that the last reported verification attempt failed.

BetaGoogleManagedStorageRegionSuspended.description: Anthropic has withdrawn or paused its approval of customer-owned storage for this profile, so the region does not apply the control.

effective_bucket.description: The bucket that the region applies now. While a replacement bucket is `pending` or `failed`, this is the previous bucket. `null` when the region applies no bucket.

BetaGoogleManagedBucketReference.description: A Cloud Storage bucket, named by the project that holds it and by its own name.

project_number.description: The number of the Google Cloud project that holds the bucket, in decimal.

BetaGoogleManagedStorageFailedCheck.description: One check that a verification attempt failed.

check.description: Which check failed, such as `label_mismatch` or `grant_mismatch`. Anthropic may add values.

message.description: What failed and, where the end customer can fix it, what to change.

role.description: On a check about one of the accounts that Anthropic uses to reach the bucket, that account's kind of access, such as `ingest`. `null` on any other check. Anthropic may add values.
